name: PM YASASVI – Top Class Education in Schools (Classes 11–12)
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
summary: Central support for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students in notified Top Class Schools; Class 11–12 students should verify the school list and available slots.
benefits: Up to ₹1,25,000 per year for Classes 11–12 under the scheme guidelines; eligible fee components and limits apply.

eligibility.incomeLimit: Family income ceiling and school/slot conditions apply; check current guidelines.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP when the relevant fresh/renewal window is open.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows application till 30 November 2026. Confirm fresh/renewal eligibility and state/class slots on NSP.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India
summary: Post-matric financial support for eligible students with benchmark disabilities continuing education after Class 10. Course, disability and income rules apply.
benefits: The department lists tuition/admission support, maintenance allowance, and book/disability allowances. Check current guidelines for the applicable fee ceiling and rates.

eligibility.identity: Valid UDID/disability certificate and current NSP conditions apply.

applicationProcess: Submit through NSP when applications are open and follow institute verification.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows student applications till 30 November 2026; check scheme specifications for exact rates.

name: Education Assistance to Wards of Beedi, Cine and Mine Workers – Post-Matric
provider: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
summary: Education assistance for eligible students whose parent is an eligible beedi, cine or specified mine worker. Worker-service, income and academic conditions apply.
benefits: The Ministry reported assistance up to ₹25,000 per student per year across eligible school, college and professional courses. Course-wise rates depend on current scheme rules.

eligibility.parentEmployment: Parent must meet the eligible worker and service conditions.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified cycle.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 post-matric application window as closed on 31 October 2026. The Ministry's 2025 release describes assistance up to ₹25,000/year; check the next cycle and course-wise rules.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS – Class 11–12
provider: HDFC Bank Parivartan (programme administrator details on official site)
summary: Financial support for Class 11–12 students facing financial difficulty or a personal/family crisis that puts continuation of education at risk.
benefits: ₹18,000 for eligible students in Classes 7–12 under the 2026–27 programme.

eligibility.preference: Preference for applicants facing a personal/family crisis in the previous three years.

applicationProcess: Use the official ECSS programme application route when the current cycle is accepting applications.
statusNote: Official programme page lists the 2026–27 cycle and a deadline of 15 December 2026. Confirm class-specific conditions and details before applying.

name: Telangana ePASS – Post-Matric Scholarship (Intermediate)
summary: Telangana ePASS includes Intermediate and vocational Intermediate courses under its post-matric course groups. Scheme eligibility, category rules, income limits and current application dates depend on the applicable notification.
benefits: Fee reimbursement and/or maintenance support may apply under the relevant Telangana post-matric scheme. No single amount is stated because it varies by category and course.

eligibility.courses: Intermediate and eligible vocational Intermediate courses (Group IV)
eligibility.other: Community, income, attendance and institution conditions vary by scheme.

requiredDocuments: Telangana residence/community and income records as applicable
applicationProcess: Use the official Telangana ePASS portal and select the relevant post-matric scheme. Confirm the college/course is approved and the current application window is active.
statusNote: The official course list explicitly includes Intermediate and vocational Intermediate (Group IV). Current 2026–27 application dates and category-specific benefits must be confirmed on ePASS.

name: Telangana ePASS – Post-Matric Scholarship (Intermediate)
scholarshipType: Post-matric fee reimbursement and maintenance support
summary: Telangana ePASS post-matric support for eligible SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled welfare-category students in Intermediate courses at eligible institutions. Category, income, attendance, admission and other rules apply.
benefits: Eligible students may receive reimbursement of eligible non-refundable tuition fees and monthly maintenance/mess support. Amounts vary by category, course group and student accommodation; check the current ePASS rate table.

eligibility.course: Intermediate (Group IV) at an eligible institution.
eligibility.income: Different category-wise annual family-income ceilings apply; consult the current official eligibility page.
eligibility.attendance: Renewal requires prescribed attendance and promotion conditions.

applicationProcess: Use Telangana ePASS Post-Matric fresh or renewal registration for academic year 2026–27. Follow the current biometric / verification instructions and confirm your category's eligibility.
statusNote: The official ePASS circular lists 2026–27 fresh and renewal registration and gives 31 March 2027 as the last date shown for fresh/renewal registrations. Recheck the live portal for extensions and category-specific instructions.
